purpose: Replace type-only labels for the Type-0x14, Type-0x2B, and Type-0x30 compact collision-response entries.

promotions.name: ActorCollision_ProcessType14Interaction

contract.cleanup: Clears/releases the source actor and runs Actor_HandleType2DInteraction on the receiver
contract.audio: Prepares audio command 3 when SCENE_VDP_UPDATE_FLAG is active

evidence: Direct source cleanup and Type-0x2D interaction helper calls

promotions.name: ActorCollision_StageType84EventResponse

evidence: Direct event flag, Type-0x84, animation, and actor-flag writes
Direct forward-slot allocation and source-position copy

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ReinitializeType30Response

evidence: Direct action-response gate and interaction-state call
Direct death-template initialization and animation-root write

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish Type-0x14 interaction cleanup, Type-0x2B Type-0x84 event staging, and Type-0x30 player response reinitialization while retaining dispatch-type aliases.
